about: Waymark's routine contract: the single source of what each task must do (block) and what is recorded and scored (record). stop-hook.mjs enforces and scores from this file; the instructions block quotes every block step's `doc`; tests/hooks.test.mjs fails if they drift. Change a step here, nowhere else. Decided by the user on 2026-10-03 (docs/adr/0006). A sub-decision marked 'preguntada tarde' passes the block but fails Decision in the evaluation (user's choice, 2026-10-03 · T2d); 'confirmada' passes. Every step that applies blocks once, except the commit trailer (fixing it rewrites a commit): user's choice, 2026-10-03 · T2j (docs/adr/0010). No browser step: browser verification runs only when the user asks for it (user's choice, 2026-10-03 · T2l, docs/adr/0011).

steps.label: Decision
steps.doc: the decision backed by the choice window or the user's words, no sub-decision taken alone

steps.label: Verificar
steps.doc: a gate after the last change

steps.label: Recordar
steps.doc: L2+: mem_search before the first change

steps.label: Review
steps.doc: L2+ with code: code-review on the task's files

steps.label: Build
steps.doc: L2+ with code: the build once at the end (or Build: no (<why>) when the project has none)

steps.label: Docs

steps.label: Previos
